title: round
description: One round of an eval (ADR-0004), optional: what it set out to learn, what changed against the round before, the arms it dropped and why, the baseline it started from, and what it concluded. data/rounds/<goal_id>/<round_id>.yaml, written by evh round-open / round-retire / round-close. It stores its arms (RFC-032 step 5): a run made with `--round` names the round and joins its system's arm.

round_id.description: r1, r2, ...: equals the file name.

study.description: The study this round belongs to (RFC-029): opened by study-run, closed when the study ends, never by hand; it does not count against the one open round of a goal.

actor.description: Who acted (RFC-027): a person, or an agent and the person it acted for. A recorded claim, not an identity.

for.description: the person an agent acted for

dataset_id.description: The dataset its arms run on.

hypothesis.description: What the round sets out to learn, in a sentence.

changes.description: What changed against `from`, and why, one line each.

baseline.description: The run it starts from and is measured against: the dataset's promoted baseline when it opened.

arms.description: The round's arms (RFC-032 step 5): each a system placed in the round, read under one label, through the runs named; a retired arm stays, with when, why and who.

label.description: What its scores are read under ("rescored 5f2c057c", "linux", "silver"); absent: the plain runs.

runs.description: The runs the arm is read through (run ids).

how.description: ran: a run of it named the round; carried: kept from an earlier round (round-open --keep, --adopt), compared without being run again.

from.description: The round it was carried from.

budget_usd.description: What the round may spend; its billed cost is shown against it.

harness.description: The harness code the round was opened on (round-open): a run of the round recording other code (instrument.harness.code_sha256) is named by evh rounds, with how to run it on this code.

commit.description: The project's commit; in a checkout of the harness, the harness's own.

code_sha256.description: The hash of the harness code that can change a measurement, as runs record it.

installed.description: True when the harness is an installed dependency, not a checkout.

scorer.description: The scorer the round is judged by (RFC-022): 12 characters of its code's sha256, recorded by round-open --scoring.

scoring.description: Each change of the scorer the round is read with (RFC-022): evh rescore --round, or round-open --scoring re-scoring the carried arms.

written.description: The labels the re-scores are read under ("rescored 5f2c057c").
